import pytest
from solution import find_minimum_range


def test_issue_example_from_prompt():
    """Example asserts smallest range for the four lists is (4, 6)."""
    result = find_minimum_range([[3, 6, 8, 10, 15], [1, 5, 12], [4, 8, 15, 16], [2, 6]])
    assert result == (4, 6)  # width 6-4=2 minimal covering 6, 5, 4, 6


def test_issue_single_element_in_each_list():
    """Smallest range includes at least one element from each array."""
    result = find_minimum_range([[10], [20], [30]])
    assert result == (10, 30)  # width 30-10=20 must span 10 to 30


def test_issue_common_element_gives_zero_width():
    """Smallest range includes at least one element from each array."""
    result = find_minimum_range([[5, 10, 15], [3, 5, 9], [5, 20]])
    assert result == (5, 5)  # width 5-5=0 with 5 present in every list


def test_issue_two_lists_closest_pair():
    """Smallest range includes at least one element from each array."""
    result = find_minimum_range([[1, 10], [2, 3]])
    assert result == (1, 2)  # width 2-1=1 beats 10-3=7 and 10-2=8


def test_issue_negative_numbers():
    """Smallest range includes at least one element from each array."""
    result = find_minimum_range([[-10, -5, 0], [-6, -3, 7]])
    assert result == (-6, -5)  # width -5-(-6)=1 beats 4, 2, 3 and 7


def test_issue_single_list_single_element():
    """Smallest range includes at least one element from each array."""
    result = find_minimum_range([[42]])
    assert result == (42, 42)  # width 42-42=0 only choice is 42


def test_issue_disjoint_lists():
    """Smallest range includes at least one element from each array."""
    result = find_minimum_range([[1, 2], [10, 11], [20, 21]])
    assert result == (2, 20)  # width 20-2=18 beats 20-1=19 and 21-2=19


def test_contract_result_is_low_high_pair():
    """Example implies result is a (low, high) pair with low <= high."""
    result = find_minimum_range([[3, 6, 8, 10, 15], [1, 5, 12], [4, 8, 15, 16], [2, 6]])
    assert isinstance(result, tuple) and len(result) == 2 and result[0] <= result[1]  # 2 endpoints, 4<=6


def test_contract_range_covers_each_array():
    """Range includes at least one element from each of the given arrays."""
    lists = [[1, 4, 9], [2, 5, 10], [3, 6, 11]]
    low, high = find_minimum_range(lists)
    assert all(any(low <= x <= high for x in arr) for arr in lists)  # each of 3 lists has 1 value inside


def test_contract_width_is_minimal():
    """Range is the smallest range that covers each array."""
    result = find_minimum_range([[1, 4, 9], [2, 5, 10], [3, 6, 11]])
    assert (result[1] - result[0]) == 2  # candidates 3-1=2, 6-4=2, 11-9=2 so min=2


def test_issue_empty_inner_list_raises():
    """Range must include at least one element from each array."""
    with pytest.raises(Exception):
        find_minimum_range([[1, 2, 3], []])
